Eric Pettersen wrote:
> So, is Dragos immune to superior Terror Frenzy?

No. Like "Strained Vitae Supply", later effects override earlier
effects. Dragos will have to pay an additional blood (meaning: one)
for each combat card he plays in that combat. [LSJ 23-FEB-1999]
